title: Symbolic Machine Learning for Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium Prediction in Cx-N2 Binary Mixtures
abstract: arXiv:2608.11255v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate prediction of vapor--liquid equilibrium (VLE) for hydrocarbon-nitrogen mixtures remains challenging for cubic equations of state, particularly across broad ranges of composition and hydrocarbon chain length. While deep learning models can provide accurate predictions, they often lack interpretability and explicit analytical expressions. In this work, we propose a symbolic machine learning approach to discover interpretable symbolic corrections to Peng-Robinson equation-of-state (PR-EOS) predictions from experimental data. The proposed approach adopts a two-level strategy: symbolic expressions are first identified for individual hydrocarbon systems, after which their coefficients are represented as functions of carbon number to enable accurate prediction across different hydrocarbon systems. The results demonstrate significantly improved prediction accuracy over the original PR-EOS across all hydrocarbon-nitrogen systems. Overall

translated_title: 用于Cx-N2二元混合物汽液相平衡预测的符号机器学习方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11255v1 公告类型：新 摘要：对于烃-氮混合物的汽液相平衡（VLE）的准确预测，对于立方状态方程而言仍具有挑战性，尤其是在广泛的组成范围和烃链长度范围内。尽管深度学习模型能够提供准确的预测，但它们通常缺乏可解释性和明确的分析表达式。在本工作中，我们提出了一种符号机器学习方法，以从实验数据中发现对Peng-Robinson状态方程（PR-EOS）预测的可解释符号修正。所提出的方法采用了两级策略：首先为单个烃系统识别符号表达式，然后将其系数表示为碳数的函数，以实现对不同烃系统的准确预测。结果表明，与原始PR-EOS相比，该方法在所有烃-氮系统中显著提高了预测精度。总体而言。
tldr: 提出了一种符号机器学习方法，通过发现可解释的符号修正项来提升Peng-Robinson状态方程对烃-氮混合物汽液相平衡的预测精度，并实现了跨不同烃系统的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This work proposes a symbolic machine learning approach that discovers interpretable symbolic corrections to the Peng-Robinson equation of state, significantly improving vapor-liquid equilibrium prediction accuracy across hydrocarbon-nitrogen systems with generalization across chain lengths.
